The principal world of the [[Morlani system]], it featured lowlands and [[ocean]]s with coastal industrial [[City|cities]]. The [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation]] operated out of Morlana One and [[Politics|governed]] the Free Trade sector, acting as an extension of surveillance for the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[5 BBY]], the [[thief]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] visited a [[Leisure Zone brothel|brothel]] in Morlana One's [[Leisure Zone]] to [[Search for Kerri|investigate]] a lead on a [[Kenari (people)|Kenari]] [[Gender|girl]] he believed could potentially be his [[Kerri|sister]]. He was harassed by two sentry guards from the [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces]], leading to a fight in which led the guards were [[Death|killed]]. The deaths were investigated by [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]] of the [[Pre-Mor Security Inspection team]], although he was ordered by [[Chief Inspector]] [[Hyne]] to leave the case and forge a story that made the Pre-Mor forces look better. Despite those orders, Karn traced the deaths to Andor on the neighboring planet [[Ferrix]]. Karn's [[Ambush on Ferrix|attempts]] to arrest Andor on Ferrix led to the deaths of four Pre-Mor [[Tac-Corpo|corpos]] and a [[Timm Karlo|civilian]], prompting the Empire to step in and take permanent authority over the Morlani system. Most staff in Preox-Morlana were removed, save for a handful that helped with the transitions of power. ==Description== {{Quote|I told Syril, when he insisted on playing at police work on Morlana, that the benefits of life here would become clear by contrast.|Eedy Karn, to ISB Supervisor Dedra Meero, on living on Coruscant|{{Andor|Harvest}}}} Morlana One,{{Databank|morlana-one|Morlana One}} or simply Morlana, was a terrestrial [[planet]] in the first [[orbit]]al position of the [[Morlani system]] within an intersecting portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[New Territories]]. It was situated in the [[Free Trade sector]], a [[Sector|subsector]] of the [[Xappyh sector]], in grid square Q-3 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. The world also lay along the [[Hydian Way]] [[super-hyperroute]]{{BuildFalconCite|48|Guide to the Galaxy}} between the [[Listehol system|Listehol]] and [[Ruuria system]]s. [[File:Morlana-One-surface-Andor101.png|thumb|left|300px|The surface of Morlana One]] Morlana One was the principal world in its [[star system]], neighbored by the planet [[Ferrix]] and astronomical object [[Morlana Four]]. Appearing relatively blue-[[color]]ed from afar, the world had a diameter of 11,236 [[kilometer]]s (6,982 miles) and was orbited by one [[moon]]. Morlana One's landscape was characterized by [[ocean]]s, coastal lowlands, and plains, along with its industrial waterfront [[City|cities]]. Considered by some to be a dreary planet, Morlana One had a Type I [[atmosphere]] breathable to [[human]]s and other [[species]], and its climate included rain and fog. ==History== ===Corporate holdings=== {{Quote|What was our friend Syril Karn doing on Morlana One?''"
"''He was there for five years. He was a corporate cop.|[[Ghorman (people)|Ghor]] rebels [[Carro Rylanz]] and [[Dilan]]|{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}}}} The principal world in the Morlani system, Morlana One grew an industry that dominated the planet, with cities rising from commercial housing. By the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the world served as the headquarters for the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation]], a company that acted as a de-facto [[Politics|government]] and [[law enforcement agency]] for the Free Trade sector while being an extension of surveillance for the Empire. [[File:SyrilKarnProfile-IHFE.png|thumb|right|300px|Syril Karn (profile pictured) became a lawman on Morlana One.]] The [[Coruscanti]] [[Syril Karn]] moved to Morlana One around [[10 BBY]]{{AndorDate|104}} That episode marks the end of [[Syril Karn]]'s career on Morlana One, which "[[I Have Friends Everywhere]]" establishes lasted for five years. Therefore, it can be deduced that Karn moved to Morlana One around [[10 BBY]]. and joined the [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces]], eventually taking the position of [[Deputy Inspector]] of the [[Pre-Mor Security Inspection team]]. This was against the wishes of his [[Parent|mother]], [[Eedy Karn]], who believed staying on the Imperial [[capital]] planet of [[Coruscant]] had far more benefits. Another member of Pre-Mor Security, [[Kravas Drezzer]], was demoted to a [[Sentry Corporal]] on Morlana One from being a [[squad]] [[commander]] on Morlana Four. Drezzer spent much of his off-duty time in Morlana One's [[Leisure Zone]], where he harassed and extorted people.''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ===Double murder=== {{Quote|You didn't mean it. He fell. We had a misunderstanding and… We'll go in together. We played too hard in hitting and you didn't understand it. He tried to grab you and… and he fell, and he hit his head. We'll go in together. We'll tell them what happened.|Kravas Drezzer tries to negotiate with Cassian Andor|}} [[File:LeisureZoneBrothel-Andor.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Cassian Andor searched for leads on his sister at a Leizure Zone brothel.]] In [[5 BBY]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], a [[thief]] and salvager from Ferrix, visited a [[Preox-Morlana Corporate Zone]] on Morlana One at nighttime, parking a [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan|starship]] just beyond a causeway and making his way to a [[Leisure Zone brothel|brothel]] in the Leisure Zone while trying to maintain a low profile.{{SWU|set=Secrets of Power|cardname=Cassian Andor|subtitle=Lay Low|link=5613349384}} The man approached a [[Unidentified hostess|hostess]] [[Search for Kerri|about]] information on a [[Kenari (people)|Kenari]] [[Gender|girl]] that had formerly worked at the place, whom he believed could be his sister [[Kerri]]. The hostess was unable to provide any information, and in the meantime, Drezzer and fellow sentry guard [[Verlo Skiff]] began trying to intimidate Andor. With Andor having deflected their comments, the pair chose to follow the man as he departed back to his [[starship]]. [[Alcohol|Drunk]] by this point,{{InsiderCite|220|On Program}} Drezzer and Skiff stopped Andor in at a plaza entrance to the causeway and held him at gunpoint, making excuses to fine the man of his possessions. Andor then attacked the two, quickly subduing Skiff before wrestling Drezzer to the ground and taking his [[B1-NA blaster pistol|blaster]]. Skiff was [[Death|dead]] from the skirmish by this point, and Andor dispatched Drezzer shortly afterwards despite the sentry guard's pleading. The thief then fled back to his ship and departed Morlana One, going back to Ferrix. ===Unsanctioned investigations=== {{Quote|This case appears to bear all the hallmarks of what I like to describe as regrettable misadventure. ''[…]'' Two dedicated Pre-Mor employees caught in the sad orbit of a rare calamity.''"
"''I don't understand.''"
"''I want you to conjure a suitable accident.|Hyne and Syril Karn|}} [[File:Hyne-Karn-report-Andor101.png|thumb|right|300px|Syril Karn speaks to Hyne about the murders of Kravas Drezzer and Verlo Skiff.]] The Pre-Mor Security Inspection team probed the deaths of Drezzer and Skiff, and Karn made a report on the incident overnight, taking it to [[Chief Inspector]] [[Hyne]] in the [[Corporate Security Headquarters]] on Morlana One the next [[Standard day|day]] and summarizing the situation to him. While Karn wished to solve the case, Hyne stopped the Deputy Inspector as he did not want to let the details of Drezzer and Skiff flouting rules get out, particularly as he was about to attend an [[Imperial Regional Command]] review to report on their crime rates. The Chief Inspector told his subordinate to instead make up a report that painted a better light on the Pre-Mor Authority's part. Despite Hyne's orders, Karn proceeded to keep following leads on the murderer, Andor, and with an [[Unidentified Astro-Traffic Control Officer|Astro-Traffic Control Officer]] he was able to spot a starship passing through Morlana One's checkpoints without identification on some starchart records. He had the control [[officer]] track the ship's journey to Ferrix. Karn then liaised with three other officers to try and find a "Kenari male" on Ferrix. The officers could not find anything on the censuses, so he made them put out a bulletin, despite their doubts that the [[Ferrixian]]s would help them. [[File:MoskReportsForDuty-ThatWouldBeMe.png|thumb|left|300px|Syril Karn recruited Linus Mosk to hunt down Cassian Andor.]] The bulletin was responded to by the Ferrixian [[Floor manager]] [[Timm Karlo]], who turned in information on Andor over jealousy that he was getting close to his [[Bix Caleen|partner]]. Back on Morlana One, the officers working with Karn processed the tip-off and pulled up a file on Andor. The Deputy Inspector arrived with the hostess from the brothel to confirm that Andor was the man she saw on the night of the murder. With his suspect confirmed, Karn called in [[Sergeant]] [[Linus Mosk]] from Pre-Mor's [[Corporate Tactical Forces]], and the pair discussed the situation and put together a team of twelve [[Tac-Corpo|corpos]] to find Andor on Ferrix.{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} ===Changes in power=== {{Quote|You will not be replaced. You've rung the final bell on Corporate independence. As of this morning, the Morlana system is under permanent Imperial authority.|Blevin, to Syril Karn|{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}}}} [[File:Morlana-Gone-Andor104.png|thumb|right|300px|Blevin dresses down Linus Mosk, Hyne, and Syril Karn.]] Karn, Mosk and their team traveled from Morlana One to Ferrix on a [[Ambush on Ferrix|mission]] to apprehend Andor,{{Andor|Aldhani (episode)}} within just two days of Drezzer and Skiff's deaths.{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} However, the mission went disastrously: four of the corpos as well as Karlo were killed, corporate and Ferrixian property was destroyed, and Andor managed to escape with a new contact, [[Luthen Rael]]. The Pre-Mor Security's embarrassing defeat quickly came to the attention of the Empire's [[Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB), with the Free Trade sector's [[ISB Supervisor]], [[Lieutenant]] [[Blevin]], reporting what he knew of it during a meeting with the [[ISB Board]] on Coruscant. The Empire moved in to the Morlani system the day after the incident on Ferrix,{{Andor|Announcement}} imposing permanent authority there, as well as the rest of the Free Trade Sector, and relieving the majority of the Pre-Mor Authority staff from their posts.{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} Blevin personally dressed down Karn, Mosk, and Hyne at the latter's Morlana One office, making them sign off an [[After-action report|ISB After Action Report]] detailing their involvement in the Ferrix incident and sending them to the transfer center to receive any personal possessions they were allowed to keep. While Karn, sent away with a full dishonor, returned to his mother on Coruscant, Mosk begun work at a smelter on Morlana One. [[File:MoskSmelter-DoF.png|thumb|left|300px|Linus Mosk contacts Syril Karn from a smelter on Morlana One.]] In the meantime, a handful of Pre-Mor Authority holdouts remained at the offices, helping with the Imperial transition there. One of them, a former partner of Mosk, was working at the headquarters night desk on Morlana One and learned from Imperial communications that Andor's [[Maarva Carassi Andor|mother]] had died and a [[Maarva's funeral procession|funeral]] was being planned on Ferrix. Having been asked by Karn to pass on any information on Andor, Mosk contacted him from the smelter and passed on his suspicion that Andor would be attending the [[funeral]]. Karn subsequently met with Mosk and the pair attempted to find Andor at the funeral on Ferrix.{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} ==Inhabitants== {{Quote|Oh, they're just sentry guards. They like to play at being cops. It's… It's annoying.|A brothel hostess, on Kravas Drezzer and Verlo Skiff|}} By 5 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], Morlana One was home to 785 million people, including humans and other species. They were governed and policed by the Preox-Morlana Corporation, which provided all civil services to its citizens, known as employees, provided that they adhere to compliance directives and log their [[Standard hour|hours]]. ==Locations== {{Quote|You're in Pre-Mor corporate zone. You know that, right? Employees are required to present their IDs upon request.''"
"''Oh, no, you didn't park out past the causeway, did ya?''"
"''I sure hope not. That's off-limits to visitors. We'd have to fine you.|Kravas Drezzer and Verlo Skiff stop Cassian Andor|}} An industrial world, Morlana One was settled with industrial waterfront cities along its coasts that grew out of commercial housing. The Preox-Morlana Corporate Zone had illuminated causeways that passed over bodies of water. There was also the Leisure Zone, a seedier part of the Corporate Zone that included brothels and attracted thrill-seekers or those seeking information. Some areas were off-limits to visitors. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|On Morlana, there was this dark, gritty, urban landscape [that demanded] something edgy, textural, a rumbling that wasn't pretty.|Nicholas Britell|{{WebCite|url=https://variety.com/2022/artisans/news/andor-composer-nicholas-britell-score-star-wars-1235383443|text=‘Andor' Composer Nicholas Britell Breaks Down His Score and Why He Incorporated Rustling Leaves|author=Burlingame, Jon|date=2022-09-26|work=[[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|''Variety'']]|archivedate=20220926170019}}}} [[File:MorlanaOneConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Concept art of Morlana One by Peter McKinstry]] Morlana One first appeared in "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," the first episode in the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}} The world was teased beforehand in a sizzle reel for the season released on [[December 10]], [[2020]],{{SWYouTube|gSW-pARyP-M|Sizzle Reel | Andor | Disney+|sw_url=video/sizzle-andor}} and its name was first mentioned in a clip teased in ''[[Andor: A Disney+ Day Special Look]]''''[[Andor: A Disney+ Day Special Look]]'' on [[September 8]], 2022.{{SW|url=news/disney-plus-day-is-here-2022|text=Disney+ Day: New ''Andor'' Special Look Revealed and More!}} Concept art of Morlana One was created by concept artist [[Peter McKinstry]].{{SW|url=andor-concept-art-gallery|text=Concept Art Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 7}} The very first sequence shot for ''Andor''{{'s}} first season was at the Morlana One brothel in "Kassa."{{SW|url=andor-s1-e1-trivia-gallery|text="Kassa" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 3}} The episode's opening on the Morlana One causeway was filmed on a pier extending from the [[Wikipedia:Coryton Refinery|Coryton Refinery]] across the [[Wikipedia:River Thames|River Thames]] in [[Wikipedia:Essex|Essex]], [[Wikipedia:England|England]]. The shoot there went from 6pm to 3am at night.{{SW|url=andor-s1-e1-trivia-gallery|text="Kassa" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 2}} Composer [[Nicholas Britell]] created an edgy, textural rumbling sound to match the dark and gritty atmosphere of Morlana One. The composer made a number of short "diagetic" music pieces to play from each club that Cassian Andor passed{{WebCite|url=https://www.vulture.com/article/nicholas-britell-andor-score-interview.html|text=Nicholas Britell Made ''Andor'' Sound Nothing Like ''Star Wars''|author=Hadidi, Roxana|date=2022-11-24|work=[[Wikipedia:Vulture (website)|''Vulture'']]|archivedate=20250406015712}} in the episode "Kassa." He also created the club music heard in the brothel in that episode as a longer track. That club music and the piece "Morlana drop" were aimed at conveying an intensity and grittiness to the world. Britell then adapted the brothel club music as the "intergalactic hit" [[Niamos!]], remixed in different contexts.
